difficulty_clamp.reason: KOTH difficulty->hardness is only monotone in [0.15, 0.80]: outside it a high-d arena re-trivializes (scripted win-rate climbs back toward 1.0). The clamp caps mapped difficulty into the band; a gentler zone_half shrink (slope 0.35, floor 0.12*width) removes the residual in-band re-easing on small maps. Keeps the 'hard' signal honest.
